editorNote: Demo edition — these sample records show how a single-author RSS desk appears. They are not a fresh fetch or a report of current events.

stories.headline: Demo sample: a practical note on evaluating an AI tool
stories.summary: This sample story stands in for an Atom entry from a single author. It demonstrates a compact source desk without claiming that a particular post was published today.
stories.whyItMatters: A dedicated author feed lets readers follow a trusted technical voice separately from broader news.
